steps.message: Create a new drawing in Simple Draw Pro. Name it amet_2023_05_12_eager_nurse.png. Save it in the Pictures folder within the sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area.

Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i -E 'simple|draw|fossify'; ls -la /storage/emulated/0/Pictures 2>/dev/null; ls -la /sdcard/Pictures 2>/dev/null; find /storage/emulated/0 -maxdepth 3 -type d | grep -i -E 'simple|draw' | head -n 50"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i -E 'simple|draw|fossify'; ls -la /storage/emulated/0/Pictures 2>/dev/null; ls -la /sdcard/Pictures 2>/dev/null; find /storage/emulated/0 -maxdepth 3 -type d | grep -i -E 'simple|draw' | head -n 50""
